name: panos-mcp
description: Inspect and manage Palo Alto Networks PA-Series firewalls and Panorama from Claude: security and NAT policies, objects, routing, VPN, logs, WildFire, GlobalProtect, and decryption, with staged commits and read-only inspection. 117 tools, running locally against your own firewall's XML API.

host.title: Firewall host
host.description: Hostname or IP of your PAN-OS firewall or Panorama, e.g. fw.example.com. Leave empty to use ~/.config/panos-mcp/firewalls.json instead.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: PAN-OS XML API key for that host. Stored in your system's secure credential store. Prefer a key for a read-only admin role.
